A small 2D arena game. Pillar: readable survival. Players can quit and resume their current health.

design/gdd/health.md.content:
# Health
## Summary
A clamped health counter notifies the HUD when changed.
## Detailed Rules
Health is clamped between 0 and max_health.
## Dependencies
The HUD reads health notifications; health never references the HUD.
## Acceptance Criteria
Damage below zero leaves health unchanged. Lethal damage clamps health to zero.

design/gdd/save.md.content:
# Save
## Summary
Resume saved health between sessions.
## Detailed Rules
Save must persist current health between sessions with a versioned schema.
## Dependencies
Save reads a snapshot from health; health does not call save.
## Acceptance Criteria
Loading a valid save restores the recorded current health.

docs/architecture/architecture.md.content:
# Pocket Arena — Master Architecture

## Document Status
- Version: 2
- Last Updated: 2026-11-04
- Engine: Godot 4.7

## System Layer Map
Health: Core. Save: unassigned. HUD: Presentation.

## Module Ownership
PRESERVE-OWNERSHIP: health alone owns current_health.

## Data Flow
PRESERVE-DATA-FLOW: health emits a read-only snapshot to save and HUD.

## Required ADRs
ADR-0002 save format (Foundation) is required before save implementation.

## Technical Requirements Baseline
| Req ID | System | Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| TR-health-001 | health | Health is clamped between 0 and max_health. |
| TR-save-001 (provisional) | save | Save must persist current health between sessions with a versioned schema. |

docs/architecture/adr-0001-health.md.content:
# ADR-0001: Health ownership

## Status
Accepted

## Date
2026-11-01

## Summary
Health owns its value and emits change notifications.

## Engine Compatibility
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Engine** | Godot 4.7 |
| **Domain** | Core |
| **Layer** | Core |
| **Post-Cutoff APIs Used** | None; no engine API prescribed |

## ADR Dependencies
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Depends On** | None |

## Decision
Health must be the only writer of current_health. Health must never depend on the HUD.

## Alternatives Considered
Direct HUD writes are rejected because they split state ownership.

## Performance Implications
No measured budget provided; no performance claim.

## GDD Requirements Addressed
| GDD System | Requirement | How |
|---|---|---|
| health.md | TR-health-001: Health is clamped between 0 and max_health. | Single owner performs clamping. |
